searchText: yeah i can ask. But I feel we won't get useful feedback now from them since I am not aware of any builder so far who has started adapting their infra with ePBS. Speaking from building buildoor, i didn't have to use it to get things to work on devnets. To understand the pool better, when a beacon node receives a proposer preferences they would cache it in their proposer preferences cache right? is that the same as the pool or would that be different. Would the cache only contain preferences for the proposers we are tracking and the pool contain all the preferences we have seen? https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/606 anyone have thoughts on allowing extra fields in peers data? a node needs to track all proposer preferences since those are required to validate bids, so serving the data should be easy what is the actual use case? what are you referencing to? the get pool version. builders will use SSE, it sounds like
